004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignClockAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignUIAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MonthlyReport;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MonthlyReport.FDNode;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.listeners.EconomyTickListener;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.MusicPlayerPluginImpl;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.procgen.StarSystemGenerator;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.shared.SharedData;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
017
018public class RetirementScript implements EveryFrameScript, EconomyTickListener {
019        public static String PLAYER_POSTPONED_RETIREMENT = "$ragingAgainstTheDyingOfTheLight";
020        public static String KEY = "$retirementScript_ref";
021        
022        public static Logger log = Logger.getLogger(RetirementScript.class);
023        //protected Boolean done = null;
024        protected long retirementTimestamp;
025        protected int retirementCost;
026        
027        protected boolean shown = false;
028        protected boolean forceTrigger = false;
029        protected float triggerAfterDelay = 0f;
030        
031        public static RetirementScript get() {
032                return (RetirementScript) Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
033        }
034        
035        public RetirementScript() {
036                float min = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_retirementMinCycles");
037                float max = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_retirementMaxCycles");
038                float cycles = min + (max - min) * StarSystemGenerator.random.nextFloat();
039                
040                retirementCost = Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_retirementDelayCostBase");
041                
042                CampaignClockAPI clock = Global.getSector().getClock().createClock(Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp());
043                clock.set(clock.getCycle() + (int) cycles, 
044                                StarSystemGenerator.random.nextInt(12), StarSystemGenerator.random.nextInt(28));
045                retirementTimestamp = clock.getTimestamp();
046                
047                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
048                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
049        }
050        
051        public void showAfterDelay(float delay) {
052                triggerAfterDelay = delay;
053                forceTrigger = true;
054        }
055        
056        public static boolean isPostponedRetirement() {
057                return Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(PLAYER_POSTPONED_RETIREMENT);
058        }
059        
060        public static boolean isEnabled() {
061                float min = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_retirementMinCycles");
062                if (min <= 0) return false;
063                
064                boolean extOnly = Global.getSettings().getBoolean("retirementEnabledExtModeOnly");
065                return !extOnly || Misc.isExtended();
066        }
067
068        public void advance(float amount) {
069                if (isDone()) return;
070                
071//              if (get() == null) {
072//                      Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
073//              }
074//              if (!Global.getSector().getListenerManager().hasListener(this)) {
075//                      Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
076//              }
077                
078                long ts = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp();
079                
080                boolean forceShow = false;
081                if (forceTrigger) {
082                        float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
083                        triggerAfterDelay -= days;
084                        if (triggerAfterDelay <= 0f) {
085                                shown = false;
086                                forceShow = true;
087                                triggerAfterDelay = 0f;
088                        }
089                }
090                
091                if (!isEnabled() && !forceShow) return;
092                
093                //ts = retirementTimestamp;
094                if (!shown && (ts >= retirementTimestamp || forceShow)) {
095                        CampaignUIAPI ui = Global.getSector().getCampaignUI();
096                        if (ui.isShowingDialog()) { 
097                                return;
098                        }
099                        SectorEntityToken token = Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().createToken(0, 0);
100                        token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MusicPlayerPluginImpl.MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY, "music_retirement_screen");
101                        String trigger = "BeginRetirement";
102                        if (forceShow) trigger = "BeginRetirementOptional";
103                        shown = Misc.showRuleDialog(token, trigger);
104                        if (shown) {
105                                if (forceTrigger) {
106                                        shown = false; // so that it will show again when time runs out
107                                }
108                                forceTrigger = false;
109                        }
110//                      if (shown) {
111//                              done = true;
112//                      }
113                }
114        }
115        
116        public boolean isDone() {
117                //return done != null && done == true;
118                return false;
119        }
120
121        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
122                return false;
123        }
124
125        @Override
126        public void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex) {
127                
128        }
129
130        @Override
131        public void reportEconomyMonthEnd() {
132                if (!isEnabled()) return;
133
134                if (!isPostponedRetirement()) return;
135                
136                int addCost = Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_retirementDelayCostPerMonth");
137                int maxCost = Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_retirementDelayCostMax");
138                
139                int cost = retirementCost;
140                retirementCost += addCost;
141                if (retirementCost > maxCost) {
142                        retirementCost = maxCost;
143                }
144        
145                if (cost <= 0) return;
146                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
147                FDNode ret = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.POSTPONE_RETIREMENT);
148                ret.upkeep += cost;
149                ret.name = "Rejuvenation treatments & cybernetics";
150                ret.custom = MonthlyReport.POSTPONE_RETIREMENT;
151                ret.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
152        }
153        
154        
155}
